constraints: Change only files you must change; a reviewer counts unnecessary file edits as a defect.
The driver must still be closed exactly once on every exit path of `plan`, including the `--discusses` early return and any exception during planning.
Do not change the public CLI surface (subcommands, flags, defaults, exit codes).
Do not weaken or delete existing behaviour of _cmd_montage, _cmd_highlights, _cmd_trip, _cmd_iterate, _cmd_render or _cmd_list.
Do not introduce a second driver or a reconnect inside planner.
Keep the S-G10 intent: real graph content must be mined through the live driver, not dropped.
known_regression: Before the fix, `shorts plan <topic>` exits 0 while silently losing the mined reveal/myth-fact content, because plan_shorts is handed a closed driver and its content_miner calls fail inside a blanket `except Exception` that logs at INFO and falls back to templated text. A second-order risk of the obvious repair (moving the whole tail of _cmd_plan inside the `try`) is regressing --discusses cleanup or leaking the driver when planning raises.
problem: In auto_ingest/shorts/cli.py the `plan` subcommand's default (non-`--discusses`) branch curates a Brief, selects the highway anchor pool, and then closes the driver in a `finally` block. The subsequent call to planner.plan_shorts(..., driver=driver) therefore receives an already-closed driver. plan_shorts only uses that driver for best-effort content mining (reveal twist, myth/fact pair) and swallows every exception, so the failure is silent: the command exits 0 and emits a Plan whose narration silently degrades to templated text, losing the real graph content the S-G10 comment says it is there to mine. Repair the ordering so planning executes while the driver is still live, while keeping discussion-mode (`--discusses`) cleanup correct: the driver must still be closed exactly once on every exit path, including the early `return 1` when no spoken discussion is found and including any exception raised during planning.
title: auto-ingest shorts plan runs after the Neo4j driver is closed
